description: British-Pakistani entrepreneur who wants to combine best-in-class practices from Britain and Europe and adapt them to Pakistan — across child pedagogy, curriculum, and child safeguarding, which is massively missing here. Believes every child should be seen as a whole, well-rounded individual, not just a footballer. You'll find him at the grounds working with coaches and parents to make sure the vision is real on the pitch.
name: Hamza Syed

description: UEFA B License. 29 years' experience coaching in North America and Europe. Directs our curriculum for recreational and competitive programming across all age groups. You'll find him hopping between different age-groups and sessions, working alongside our coaches to ensure every kid gets the maximum from their time on the pitch.
name: Steve Hamilton

description: Seasoned operations executive running day-to-day club operations across the four branches. You'll see him hopping around our branches making sure they're running smoothly — say hi when you spot him.
name: Sarmad Hussain

description: Knows the Lahore football scene back of his hand. Directs the club's competition structure — the ELJPL and LJPL youth leagues — manages school and club partnerships across the city, and handles league registration enquiries.
name: Zain Shoukat

description: Leads international and domestic tour operations, managing itineraries, logistics, and partnerships with clubs and facilities across Pakistan and abroad.
name: Tahir Mehmood
